title: Relational databases
brief: Understand shared relational facts, questions and guarded changes through one shop purchase. Distinguish schema rules, atomicity, concurrent decisions, query work and durability, judge relational fit and choose a practical next route.
ownership_note: Introduce enough of each concern to choose a route; children own detailed design, formal analysis and working procedures.

title: SQL at the application boundary
brief: Preserve query meaning and transaction ownership across drivers, pools and ORMs. Separate parameters from SQL structure, map results, bound repeated queries, and handle one request’s connection, error and cancellation coherently.

neighbouring_ownership.capacity: Owns pool sizing, admission and overload.
neighbouring_ownership.outboxes-jobs: Owns durable external intentions and worker recovery.
neighbouring_ownership.access-control: Owns authority of application and administrative identities.

title: Transactions and isolation
brief: Choose atomic work and isolation from the invariant being preserved. Distinguish committed visibility, statement and transaction snapshots and serial outcomes; develop sound one-row stock and multi-row capacity protocols.

neighbouring_ownership.locks: Owns explicit lock scope, ordering and wait diagnosis.
neighbouring_ownership.storage-durability: Owns how versions and logs implement physical history, without treating storage versions as business history.

title: Retries and uncertain commit outcomes
brief: Distinguish a known abort from a commit whose reply was lost. Reuse one logical request identity, reject conflicting payloads, and recover the recorded result rather than applying a purchase twice.

neighbouring_ownership.outboxes-jobs: Owns external delivery and worker identity.
neighbouring_ownership.application-sql: Owns error transport and connection disposal.
neighbouring_ownership.crdb-transactions: Owns native retry and ambiguous-result errors.

title: Live schema changes and backfills
brief: Move through compatible schema and caller states using expand, migrate and contract. Prove a backfill converged despite races and late rows, and define acceptance and return boundaries.

neighbouring_ownership.writes: Owns import mechanics outside a live compatibility protocol.
neighbouring_ownership.pg-schema-change: Owns PostgreSQL locks, rewrites and index validity.
